🏔️ How Mountains Are Created 🌍
Mountains are formed over millions of years due to powerful movements inside the Earth. When tectonic plates collide, the land pushes upward and creates massive mountain ranges. Some mountains are formed by volcanic eruptions, while others rise due to faults and crust movement. Wind, water, and glaciers later shape them into the peaks we see today.
Nature’s power is slow… but unstoppable. 🔥
